final: SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price), AVG(total_line_count), AVG(avg_share) FROM (SELECT company, AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(line_count) AS total_line_count, AVG(line_share) AS avg_share FROM (SELECT invoice_id, company, avg_unit_price, line_count, line_count * 1.0 / totals.total_line_count AS line_share FROM (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, c.Company AS company, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS line_count FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Company) AS invoice_groups JOIN (SELECT SUM(line_count) AS total_line_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) AS line_count FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Company)) AS totals ON totals.total_line_count IS NOT NULL) AS shares GROUP BY company) AS company_rows
